## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A small path stamped at positions along a host path: arrowheads, dots, SVG
// markers. The marker's own geometry is scaled to Size; ReferencePoint is the
// point in the marker's space that lands on the host path. When OrientToPath
// is true the marker rotates to follow the host path's tangent.
type PathMarker
    implements IValue
{
    Path: Path2D;
    Size: Size2D;
    ReferencePoint: Vector2D;
    OrientToPath: Boolean;
}

// Controls for offsetting (insetting or outsetting) a path by a signed
// distance. Positive distances offset to the left of each contour's direction
// of travel, which expands counter-clockwise-wound closed contours. Join and
// MiterLimit shape the corners of the offset result; Cap shapes the ends of
// open contours. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parallel_curve)
type PathOffsetParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Distance: Number;
    Join: LineJoin;
    MiterLimit: Number;
    Cap: LineCap;
}

// Controls for converting a dashed traversal of a path into concrete sub-path
// pieces (dash-to-path), one open contour per drawn interval of the pattern.
// Cap describes how the resulting pieces are intended to be terminated when
// stroked.
type PathDashParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Pattern: DashPattern;
    Cap: LineCap;
}
```
